title: Shab e Unwee Maah Ramzan Di Hayi
body:
Shab e Unwee Maah Ramzan Di Hayi, Runa Paak Ameer Namaz De Wich
Dhitta Ronda Ay Saaqi E Kausar Kun, Ro Payi Taqdeer Namaz De Wich
<<DIVIDER>>
1)Jadaan Jibraaeel Elaan Kitta, Thi Qatal Geya Ay Paak Ali
Hy Ummal Musayyb Musalley Te, Jhanr Payi Tattheer Namaz De Wich
<<DIVIDER>>
2)Takbeeratul Ehraam Parhi, Aya Hath Makhdoom Da Gal Thori
Dhiyan Te NuhAaan De Hath Wich, Yaad Aye Zanjeer Namaz De Wich
<<DIVIDER>>
3)Allahu Akbar Naal Syed, Hath Khol Qeyaam Shuru Kitta
Akbar Da Seena Yaad Aya, Parhda Takbeer Namaz De Wich
<<DIVIDER>>
4)Makhdoom Qeyaam De Baad Jadaan, Kitta Paak Rakuu Tah Pag Dhal Gayi
Bazaar’ch Turda Nazar Aaya, Sajjad Aseer Namaz De Wich
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir De Babay Wain Kitta, Kus Gaye Shabbir Namaz De Wich
<<DIVIDER>>
6)Lagi Sar Te Zarab Qaza Jis Dum, Gayi Deed Ali Di Karbal Ton
Olaaad De Saray Zakhmaan Di, Ubhri Tasweer Namaz De Wich
